name: usage-guard
description: Tells Claude when your plan's usage limits are getting close, so it conserves usage and then winds down with a handoff before you hit them.

enabled.title: Enable alerts
enabled.description: Turn usage alerts on or off without uninstalling.

five_hour_warn.title: 5-hour: warn at %
five_hour_warn.description: Claude starts conserving usage at this share of the 5-hour limit.

five_hour_wind_down.title: 5-hour: wind down at %
five_hour_wind_down.description: Claude wraps up and writes a handoff at this share of the 5-hour limit.

seven_day_warn.title: Weekly: warn at %
seven_day_warn.description: Claude starts conserving usage at this share of the weekly limit.

seven_day_wind_down.title: Weekly: wind down at %
seven_day_wind_down.description: Claude wraps up and writes a handoff at this share of the weekly limit.

spend_limit_warn.title: Spend limit: warn at %
spend_limit_warn.description: For Claude apps gateway users: conserve at this share of your spend limit.

spend_limit_wind_down.title: Spend limit: wind down at %
spend_limit_wind_down.description: For Claude apps gateway users: wrap up at this share of your spend limit.

handoff_path.title: Handoff file
handoff_path.description: Where Claude writes its handoff when winding down, relative to the project root.

resume_max_wait.title: Longest wait to schedule a resume
resume_max_wait.description: Claude only schedules a resume prompt if usage resets within this time, e.g. 90m or 6h.

commit_on_wind_down.title: Commit when winding down
commit_on_wind_down.description: Also ask Claude to commit work in progress when winding down.

messages_dir.title: Custom messages folder
messages_dir.description: Optional folder with warn.md, wind-down.md or wind-down-subagent.md to replace the default messages.
